name: Dagster Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source data orchestration with Python-defined assets/jobs, schedules, sensors, run monitoring and local Dagster UI; self-managed execution has no vendor-imposed software run quota.
watch_out: Run and maintain the Dagster webserver/daemon, code locations, storage and execution infrastructure yourself; compute, database, logging and external services may cost money. Dagster+ managed Cloud features and support are separate paid products.
